title: Morning Brief Edition v3
description: One Edition: the shared set of checked Items from one gathering run, covering every Topic any Reader follows. The gathering side posts it to the app's ingest endpoint (POST /api/editions). Each Edition is complete: the evening Edition already carries the morning's Items that are still current, plus new and updated ones, and the app builds every Brief from the latest Edition alone. Closed objects: unknown fields are rejected.

edition_id.description: Stable id of this Edition, for example 2026-11-14-morning. Posting the same edition_id again is idempotent.

kind.description: morning is the 06:00 full run, evening the 19:15 refresh (Asia/Riyadh).

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of this run, with the +03:00 (Asia/Riyadh) offset. The latest Edition is the one with the newest generated_at.

items.description: Every Item in this Edition. Item ids are unique within the Edition.

threads.description: The Story Threads that Items in this Edition link to with thread_id. Thread ids stay stable across Editions.

top_stories.description: Optional fallback: one to three Item ids from this Edition, used as top stories when per-Reader top picking fails. The first is the lead.

title.description: Publisher or account name. The first source is the card link.

type.description: independent: reputable independent media. wire: Reuters, AP or AFP. social: a post or video. official: government, club or company channel. A state outlet is never the only source.

id.description: Stable id. Reuse it when the same event continues in a later Edition; the app replaces the stored Item with the same id. A new development in a story is a new Item on its Story Thread.

topics.description: Topic ids, at least one. The Item is shown once, under the Reader's best-matching followed Topic, with the others as tags.

thread_id.description: Optional Story Thread id; it must be listed in the Edition's threads.

status.description: new on first appearance, updated when the same event changed since the previous Edition, empty afterwards. Omitted means no badge.

time.description: RFC 3339 time of the event. Shown as relative time; the Brief lists newest first.

image.description: Card picture (article og:image, or a YouTube thumbnail). Never gore. Explicit media only on an Adult Trending Item marked nsfw_media.

image_kind.description: What the picture is: photo fills the card; card (a logo, an Open Graph card, a screenshot of text) is shown as a badge on a white plate; none is no usable picture (a plain card). Optional: a missing value reads as photo when there is an image, else none. The gathering tool requires it in drafts.

nsfw_media.description: Adult Trending only: the Item's media is explicit. The app keeps it blurred until tapped, whatever the Reader's blur switch says.

claim_subject.description: The named person a claim in the Item is about. The gathering tool drops the Item unless a non-Reddit outlet report is among its sources; the app ignores it.

warning.description: Short content note for Items in a Sensitive Topic (Graphic, Adult Trending).

voices.description: Zero to three social posts about the story (carried over from v2).

kind.description: AI Items: MODEL, TOOL, APP or PAPER. Game Items: NEWS, RELEASE, TRENDING, TRAILER, PREVIEW, UPDATE, DEAL or PICK.

try_url.description: AI: where to try it now.

pricing.description: AI: Free, Free demo, Free tier, Paid or Open weights.

metric.description: AI or social: a headline number.

genres.description: Games: the first genre is shown on the card.

reliability.description: Liverpool: Official is club or league only.

widgets.description: Widget data that comes from gathering. Weather and prayer times are fetched live by the app and are not part of the Edition.

topic.description: Topic id; only Readers who follow it see the countdown.
